description: Creates a document from a template: one person per role, values for its data keys. With send=true PenlyDoc immediately e-mails the people with delivery EMAIL; confirm the people and values with the user first. With send=false it creates a draft the user can review in the console. Use the same externalRef/idempotencyKey to safely retry.

data.description: Values for the template data keys, e.g. {"Rent": "950 EUR"}

externalRef.description: Your own reference, e.g. an order or contract number

delivery.description: EMBEDDED = no e-mail; you show the signing page in your own app

roles.description: Keyed by role key from list_templates, e.g. {"tenant": {"name": "Mia Novak", "email": "mia@example.com"}}

send.description: true = e-mail people now; false = draft

name: send_from_template
title: Send from a template
